I want to immediately address what was just said when Dr. Price said, well, we don't have manuscript evidence. But the manuscript evidence we have demonstrates something about what was going on in the decades and years beforehand. There was never a Christian Uthman. There is no evidence whatsoever and all sorts of evidence against the idea there is ever a standardization of text.
The fact that the papyri contain the most variants from one another demonstrate there was never a standardization of text whatsoever. There was never any Uthman who could gather up the codices, as we see in Sahih al-Bukhari 6, 5, 10, and create the edited version. Even Uthman did not succeed. The fact of the matter is that the New Testament textual evidence absolutely contradicts any idea of a standardization of text.
